From the project's Random Forest model (R² = 0.874): how much someone uses AI predicts gain far better than which tool, role, or industry they're in. The charts below explore why.
About this dashboard — This is the exploratory data analysis (EDA) layer behind the AI Workforce Advisor notebook. The distribution chart mirrors Notebook Section 3.2, the Industry × Tool heatmap and Tasks-vs-Gain scatter provide the evidence behind the model's Section IV-C feature-importance finding, and every filter below lets you reproduce the patterns the model was trained on.
